applies_to: any AI-assisted workflow with issue/task → agent work → checks → human review (frontend, backend, data, infra, docs, mixed)

ai_mapping_rule.duty: Map whatever evidence the team has onto the nearest top-level metric. Do not invent domain-specific metrics.
method: Read the failure/success evidence in the team's own words (logs, PR, ticket, CI, QA, human notes).
Choose the closest metric id from top_level_metrics.
Cite the evidence snippet that justifies the mapping.
If two metrics fit, pick the dominant one for this round; mention the secondary.
Propose ONE improvement that raises R or lowers D for that metric, using the team's available controls (or a generic control class).
non_goals: Do not assume UI, API, DB, or infra — use only what the evidence shows.
Do not create per-stack metric names (a11y, schema, terraform, …); map those signals into Hc/O/Cb/σspec/R/V_obs.

loop: AI maps observed failures to nearest top-level metrics
Pick ONE intervention targeting the dominant worsened metric
Human approves; apply via improve skill / automations / CLI
If a new failure mode repeats with no catalog fit, trial-and-error a candidate control

top_level_metrics.name: Observed validity
top_level_metrics.means: Fraction of stated requirements / checks satisfied at the latest workflow checkpoint
top_level_metrics.how_applied: Whatever the team uses as ground truth: acceptance criteria, tests, QA checklist, policy checks, or human verification — graded per run, rolled up by difficulty
generic_signals: required checks failed at end of run
agent claimed done while requirements unmet
same difficulty band worse than prior round
map_examples: failing unit/integration tests → V_obs
unchecked acceptance criteria → V_obs
failed compliance/security gate → V_obs
human rejects deliverable as incomplete → V_obs
top_level_metrics.ai_prompt: Name which requirements/checks failed; map each to a decay or recovery metric; propose one change.

top_level_metrics.name: Equilibrium trust
top_level_metrics.means: R/(R+D) — expected trust if current recovery and decay levels persist
top_level_metrics.how_applied: Directional from enabled controls vs pressures; fitted per setup after calibration
generic_signals: work looks productive but trust stays low
harder tasks systematically need more recovery than the setup provides
map_examples: many successful-looking agent runs but frequent human rework → V_star low
recovery added but decay pressures also rose → V_star flat

top_level_metrics.name: Contextual entropy
top_level_metrics.means: Confusion and error accumulation in the agent’s working context (failed tools, thrash, saturated history) that corrupts later steps
top_level_metrics.how_applied: Token/context use and tool-failure rate when available; otherwise qualitative thrash in logs/transcripts
generic_signals: long failed attempt loops
repeated tool/command errors
late break after earlier steps looked fine
map_examples: agent retries same wrong API/command many times → Hc
context flooded with failed experiments then wrong conclusion → Hc
chat/tool trace shows thrash then silent regression → Hc
how_to_improve: Give grounded context (docs, schemas, runbooks, MCP/tools) so the agent stops guessing
Enforce stop-boundary: done only with evidence
Narrow task scope when thrash dominates
top_level_metrics.retest: Comparable difficulty task; expect less thrash and higher V_obs

top_level_metrics.name: Change opacity
top_level_metrics.means: How hard the deliverable is for a human (or gate) to review — size, spread, mixed concerns
top_level_metrics.how_applied: Diff/patch stats, files/systems touched, or qualitative review burden
generic_signals: very large or sprawling change set
review time dominates
reviewers skim and miss defects
map_examples: huge multi-file PR → O
one ticket changing many services/modules → O
mixed refactor + feature in one delivery → O
how_to_improve: Require smaller deliveries / clearer commit cadence
Add assisted review for first pass; keep human on high-risk parts
Deepen human review while opacity is high
top_level_metrics.retest: Same outcome as smaller units; opacity and review burden should fall

top_level_metrics.name: Blast radius
top_level_metrics.means: How widely a mistake can propagate (dependents, shared contracts, production blast)
top_level_metrics.how_applied: Dependency/impact reach when available; otherwise declared blast (shared module, public contract, prod path)
generic_signals: change in a widely reused surface
breakage outside the edited area
high-cost failure if wrong
map_examples: shared library/module change → Cb
public API / schema / event contract → Cb
auth, billing, migration, or prod infra touch → Cb
cross-cutting workflow step used by many jobs → Cb
how_to_improve: Pin acceptance checks for cross-cutting behaviors
Add regression checks aimed at dependents/callers
Require deeper human review on high blast work even when automated gates are green
Ground agents in authoritative contracts/context for that surface
top_level_metrics.retest: Same high-blast task class; defects caught by gates/repair earlier, not only by humans late

top_level_metrics.name: Specification ambiguity
top_level_metrics.means: Unclear or contested requirements — agents invent scope; humans disagree on done
top_level_metrics.how_applied: Raw vs refined task specs; missing acceptance criteria; conflicting interpretations
generic_signals: vague ticket/prompt
acceptance criteria missing or written after the fact
agent and human disagree on completion
map_examples: one-line ask with no acceptance tests → sigma_spec
scope expands during the run → sigma_spec
multiple stakeholders redefine done mid-flight → sigma_spec
how_to_improve: Require development-ready tasks with pinned acceptance criteria before agent start
Block start on high-difficulty work that is still raw/ambiguous
top_level_metrics.retest: Same task with refined acceptance only; first-pass success should rise

top_level_metrics.name: Recovery strength
top_level_metrics.means: Strength of safeguards that detect and repair invalid work before (or instead of) relying on hope
top_level_metrics.how_applied: Which recovery controls actually ran: deterministic gates, review/QA agents, repair loops, stop-boundary, context, assisted review
generic_signals: false completion reaches a human
no detect/repair trail on a bad delivery
done claimed without evidence
map_examples: no automated check failed though deliverable was wrong → R_recovery weak
no repair attempt after a known failure → R_recovery weak
gates exist but were skipped/disabled → R_recovery weak
how_to_improve: Turn on missing detect+repair loop controls first
Add stop-boundary so done requires evidence
Keep human review; deepen it until recovery catches up
top_level_metrics.retest: Known-bad case should be caught by a gate/repair step before or at first review

top_level_metrics.name: First-pass success
top_level_metrics.means: Fully correct on first delivery, before repair rounds
top_level_metrics.how_applied: Success on first attempt; track separately from success-after-repair
generic_signals: needs multiple repair rounds
only becomes acceptable after human or repair agent intervention
map_examples: QA/repair loop fixed it on attempt 2+ → pass_at_1 failed even if final V_obs recovered
human had to redirect the agent once → pass_at_1 weak
top_level_metrics.ai_prompt: If pass_at_1 fell but final V_obs recovered, prevention/stop-boundary is weak while repair may be working.

control_classes.spec_clarity: Make the task contract machine-clear before work starts
control_classes.context: Ground the agent with authoritative project/domain tools and instructions
control_classes.checkpointing: Smaller bounded steps/commits to limit damage
control_classes.deterministic_gate: Non-agent checks that must pass (tests, lint, policy, build)
control_classes.review_repair_loop: Detect failures and repair within a capped loop
control_classes.assisted_review: Extra automated review aid; never replaces human review

failure_to_metric_hints.pattern: claimed done while requirements still failing
widely shared surface broke something else
change set too large or hard to review
automated green but later review finds defect

trial_and_error.rule: Change one control per round; keep difficulty band fixed; log delta
promote_new_control_when: Failure mode repeats and no control class fits cleanly
Human names a missing gate that would have caught it
Later contrast shows positive ΔV_obs / Δpass_at_1
